evidence.title: GitHub - yaminncco/deska-dashboard-template: A dashboard template built with Nuxt, Tailwind and Shadcn.

name: Deska Dashboard Template
summary: Nuxt dashboard template with shadcn-vue: data tables, kanban, calendar, mails and file manager.
description: A dashboard template built with Nuxt, Tailwind and shadcn-vue (Shadcn), with dark/light themes and RTL/LTR support. The showcase includes a dashboard overview, users data table, tasks kanban, mails, events calendar with month/week/agenda views, file manager and user settings. The GitHub version is free; a premium version with one-time purchase and lifetime updates is sold separately.
